curriculum_point: Activate the labels cup, plate, spoon, bowl
rationale: L001 is a lexical grounding lesson about ordinary table objects. Four labels constitute one 4x4 set but not enough material for the complete lesson. A second coherent four-label set makes the lesson substantial while preserving the lexical point and avoiding later grammar instruction.

language_boundary.rule: All learner-facing scored responses remain bare labels or nonverbal selections; machine controls must not smuggle in later sentence forms.

symmetry_rule: Two sets of four vocabulary items. Within each set, every label receives affirmative, negative, W, and OR presentation-plus-controlled treatment before mixed practice.
human_note: Approved in handhold mode on 2026-08-27: cup, plate, spoon, bowl; fork, knife, glass, napkin.
